content.short: Indigo Protocol is a premier DeFi platform on Cardano for creating and trading synthetic real-world assets.
content.description: Indigo Protocol is a leading decentralized finance platform on Cardano that enables the creation of capital-efficient synthetic assets. Known as iAssets, these tokens track the price of real-world assets, including cryptocurrencies and commodities, allowing users to gain exposure without direct ownership. The protocol utilizes Collateralized Debt Positions where users deposit ADA to mint assets like iUSD, iBTC, and iETH. Governed by the Indigo DAO, the platform prioritizes decentralization and security, making global markets accessible to anyone with a Cardano wallet and internet connection.
